title: Thai Coconut Mini Pancakes
summary: Small, tender coconut pancakes inspired by Thai street sweets, with crisp golden edges and a soft, creamy middle. They make a lovely vegetarian dessert served warm with fruit or a little extra coconut milk.
steps: Whisk the coconut milk, egg and sugar in a large bowl until smooth and the sugar starts to dissolve.
Add the plain flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt and desiccated coconut. Whisk to a smooth, pourable batter, then rest for 10 minutes so the coconut softens slightly.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat and brush lightly with vegetable oil.
Spoon small rounds of batter into the pan, about 1 tablespoon each. Cook for 2–3 minutes, until the edges look set, the undersides are golden and small bubbles appear on top.
Flip carefully and cook for another 1–2 minutes, until puffed, lightly golden and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, oiling the pan lightly as needed.
Serve the mini coconut pancakes warm with diced mango.
